inv_target_present.name: inv_target_present
inv_target_present.value: (invitee_id IS NOT NULL) OR (invitee_email IS NOT NULL)

pm_consent_required.name: pm_consent_required
pm_consent_required.value: (status = 'pending_onboarding'::text) OR (role = 'administrator'::text) OR ((consent_accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consent_text_snapshot IS NOT NULL))

ro_removal_paired.name: ro_removal_paired
ro_removal_paired.value: (removed_at IS NULL AND removed_by IS NULL) OR (removed_at IS NOT NULL AND removed_by IS NOT NULL)

rd_closed_at_matches_status.name: rd_closed_at_matches_status
rd_closed_at_matches_status.value: (status = 'open'::text AND closed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'closed'::text AND closed_at IS NOT NULL)
